message: The compile-time code of the project contains C# errors, so it cannot be compiled. Fix the C# errors reported in the compile-time code.
rationale: The message gives no way forward and does not say that the actual C# errors are reported separately. The report site (CompileTimeCompilationBuilder.ProduceCompileTimeCodeRewriter.TransformCompileTimeType) reports this error in addition to the C# errors of the compile-time type, as a safeguard in case they are not shown.
codeChange: The diagnostic is reported without a location (CreateRoslynDiagnostic( null, default )). Passing the location of the compile-time type (symbol.GetDiagnosticLocation()) would tell the user which type fails to compile.
engineBug: In CompileTimeCompilationBuilder.ProduceCompileTimeCodeRewriter.cs, around line 500, the report of LAMA0068 is nested inside 'if ( this._parent._logger.Warning != null )', so the diagnostic is reported only when warning-level logging is enabled for the CompileTime category (the default NullLogger returns null). The comment above the call says the error must always be reported; move the Report call out of the logger check.
